modern_api_policy: Keep the included SDL2 Jai API and use current authoritative system SDK documentation when extending it; do not change its major ABI or add unrelated SDL3 modules.

authoritative_online_sources.role: current native signature and platform behavior
maintained SDL2 manual SDK CMake workflow
maintained ALSA PCM stream and recovery contract

known_gaps: All 127 prior adapter procedures now have independently authored source bodies; native ABI, type checking, device I/O, GUI behavior, and scheduling behavior have not been validated.
The optional X11 sofd library remains an unavailable external contract; its retained foreign declarations are not implementations.
PS5 source files were absent from the supplied contract tree and remain missing declared loads.
The frozen parser rejects the preserved DirectSound CreateSoundBuffer callback-field default outer: **void = null.

Platform playback currently negotiates stereo signed-16 output. Alternate device selection, negotiated surround layouts, focus muting, disconnect recovery, and historical engine timing/quality parity are not verified or fully implemented.
Vorbis decoding requires the independently built trusted jai_stb_vorbis_adapter SDK; no native SDK or reference distribution was loaded here.
The SDL manual CMake workflow delegates to independently obtained upstream source, keeps historical SOURCE_PATH metadata, and has not been executed.
Icon post-write behavior depends on independently implemented Windows_Resources.
Preserved legacy SDK ABI layouts have not been checked exhaustively against installed current SDK headers.

verification.method: source-only contract token inventory, independent source parsing, SDK contract and ownership review
